open_points.subject: symbolic links created in the data directory after startup
open_points.text: A18 rule 2 says “The database file and its journal are opened by SQLite ... and the kernel does not watch them after it,” while A18’s formal invariant says “symlink_inside(data_directory) -> refused” and State 3 says `store` owns “refusal of symbolic links.”
open_points.question: Does the symbolic-link refusal guarantee exclude a database or journal link introduced after the startup check, and if so must the formal invariant and `store` responsibility be narrowed to state that exception?
options: Later database and journal links are the explicit exception; only startup scanning covers them.
Every later symbolic link anywhere in the data directory must be refused, requiring some owner to detect SQLite database and journal links.
The formal invariant applies only when startup or a store-managed file open encounters the link.
open_points.default_guess: Treat later database and journal links as the explicit exception and qualify the invariant and `store` responsibility accordingly.
